title: Arithmetic, Comparison, and Logical Operators
learning_objectives: You can calculate mathematical expressions using arithmetic operators
You can evaluate truth values using comparison and boolean logic

prerequisites_check.question: What is the key principle behind Arithmetic, Comparison, and Logical Operators?
prerequisites_check.explanation: Python requires adhering to clear lexical and semantic rules.

explanation_simple: Operators are math and logic signs like plus, minus, equal to, and and/or, used to combine numbers and check conditions.
explanation_technical: Operators invoke special dunder methods on operands (__add__, __eq__) with short-circuit evaluation semantics on and/or.
syntax:
result = a + b
is_valid = x > 0 and y < 10
